764dce86c4.q: What percentage of data breaches involve the human element according to Verizon's 2023 report?
764dce86c4.a: According to Verizon's 2023 data breach investigations report, 74% of breaches involve the human element, including errors, privilege misuse and carelessness. This statistic highlights that most security breaches are not caused by clever attackers but by human mistakes.
